title: Footwork Beginner - 2 Weeks
description: Master the absolute essentials of JKD movement: Step and Slide, and Slide and Step. Build a solid foundation of balance and mobility.

days.notes: Introduction to Step and Slide. Focus on lead-foot initiation and maintaining a consistent stance width.
Introduction to Slide and Step. Essential for retreating while staying ready to counter.
Basic transitions. Practice moving forward then immediately backward.
Rest day. Focus on keeping your legs relaxed.
Deep dive into Step and Slide. Work on all directions: forward, backward, left, right.
Deep dive into Slide and Step. Ensure the rear foot slides smoothly before the lead foot steps.
Rhythm and balance. Maintain your center of gravity while alternating patterns.
Week 1 complete! Review your progress and let your muscles recover.
Increased volume. Focus on precision in lead-hand stance.
Increased volume. Focus on precision in lead-hand stance while retreating.
Integration of rotations. Add 90-degree turns to your movement.
Endurance day. Keep moving throughout the session without losing form.
Combining linear and lateral movements. Total control of basic patterns.
Graduation Day. You've mastered the foundation of JKD footwork!

Author: Antoine Giniès
